item.title: Affordable homes to be built next to LRT, MRT stations – Kayu Ara, Sri Andalas, Bdr Bukit Tinggi, Johan Setia
item.description: Surely there’s no reason not to take public transport for daily commuting when you’re living adjacent to a train station? Good news for urban workers – the government is planning transit-oriented development (TOD) projects on the land it owns around train stations, and it will be affordable housing.
